title: Episode About Marathas And the Khalsa Panth...

blocks.text: The alliance with Dina Beg now turns toward Sirhind, but the Singhs make clear that they will not be bought off as hired auxiliaries. They refuse ordinary payment, demand formal license to plunder the hostile city, and insist that the Nawab confirm the arrangement with an oath on the holy Koran before the campaign proceeds.

Once that sanction is secured, the Khalsa throws itself into the attack on Sirhind with the same hard resolve it had shown in the Doaba fighting. The city and its fort are struck with such force that the expedition becomes both a military assault and a contest over who will control the spoils of victory.

That success quickly creates friction with the Marathas, who resent the scale of Sikh plunder and prestige. The page therefore ends with the beginnings of a scuffle between Singhs and Marathas, showing that their cooperation already contains the seeds of betrayal.
